notes.title: Taboo University Book Two Release 3 has launched!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/b17612ceb73e885c0df48cd28ada858fc23eeae8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The new Release for [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-two-release-138097728"]Taboo University - Book 2 is now available.[/url][/b][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-two-release-138097728"] [/url][/p][p][/p][p]👂❓ What's new, you ask? Good question! Lots - that's what. [/p][p][i]Each of the storylines reaches a tense climax in this chapter,[/i] setting the stage for the entire rest of the game - it's deep, it's emotional, and most importantly, it's hot as fuck - with Mc reaping the many, many benefits.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/162ed295b46dab2e8efd08f84724a59a564063e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🥇In the Winner's club, we've got you being torn between many of the tense and worried characters of the club, all looking to you for support:[/p][p]-- [b]Monika [/b]of all people is looking for any chance to blow off some steam, and seeing you and Olesya being casually friendly during a practice is just the bad reason she needs to make a sexy scene out of herself for you.[/p][p]-- [b]Isa [/b]needs help as well! With no one else to turn to in confidence, she seeks you out to ask for your help in her election efforts amid the drug scandal. Should you be on her path instead of Sam's, she's even willing to trust you to help calm her nerves a bit...[/p][p]-- [b]Silvia [/b]is feeling a little isolated with all the negativity as well, and unfortunately, she's been pretty swamped to the point of frustration, leading her to take some indulgent initiative with her new boyfriend the first chance she gets![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/c3d1c35843a31e50ee7cb85197f42d0b0566dd52.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🍃Meanwhile, the mysterious Children of Narrura are far from idle. Mc makes some serious investigative plays in this chapter in order to learn more information.[/p][p]- Fortunately, [b]Delphia [/b]has always been someone to find enjoyment in breaking the rules, and fortunately, when she finds out you're sneaking around, she is turned towards rewarding you rather than chastising you.[/p][p]- Afterward, someone else is looking to do a little rule-breaking of her own... [b]Ivy [/b]wants another taste after your previous tryst, and she has just the plan to wear out the rest of the communers - [b]Yvonne, Sloan, and Nirium[/b] -  to get some private time with you.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/937a267c28550063b60a8d8ecf3a0d16be0bed55.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]💰Finally, big happenings in the Syndicate.[/p][p]- If you were brave (or foolish) enough to make contact with [b]Corrine [/b]before her more altruistic sister, it's time for her to earn her keep - in exchange for bail. With her back on the streets, though, she's more than poised to make that everyone else's problem... and your pleasure.[/p][p]- And it's time to find out if the Wasp's money is where their mouths are. The task of testing this supposed golden business deal falls to you, [b]Zemfira and Foxy[/b]. It's good - it's better than good, even. And at Zemfira's prodding, it might get even better... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/2285299aa7bc40f8087437ca0cf356e730457193.png"][/img][/p][p] And that's just the beginning. There's tons more to see waiting for you, culminating in a big, big decision for Mc to make at the end. Faced with the results of the choices he's made so far, it's time to stop passing the buck... who are you? What do you want? And what are you willing to do to get it?[/p][p]  🔥 [b]17 shining scenes [/b]🔥 [b]2700 stunning renders [/b]🔥 [b]166 original animations[/b][/p][p]The hour is here - no more waiting. Time to act.[i] [/i]Dive back into the world of [i]Taboo University[/i] today![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/e2b77e62decccdda105efd026afca44dcd8dddb9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Meet the Studio: Min Eun-Soo
notes.content:
[p]Min Eun-Soo dove headfirst into the exciting world of the Fetish Locator app when it reached her hands. She actually hosted massive parties at her home so that people could come and experience the true potential of kinks, both familiar and unfamiliar to them. One of these parties is where the two of you met. 😎👅💦[/p][p][/p][p]You already knew her from classes, but when you got to see her in her kinky element, you realized that Min was the whole flipping package. She's an ace in her business classes and has a natural competitive side that made her quite the partner in crime during Fetish Locator parties and wherever else the two of you met up for a little sticky fun. 😍 💦🌊[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/f8d53d1522858d92c5ec1d6a7facad14925a47ab.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Later on in the story, Min ended up facing down an unexpected turn of events, same as the main character. Thick skin or no, when people get hit in their blindspots, it can take a toll. Min was a bit lost after the events leading to the end of Week 3 and ended up spending some time away.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/9efa7ef2d25a49cca8993c1d0844c300cac3129b.png"][/img][/p][p]But now in Fetish Locator S&M Studio, she is back with a vengeance. 😁🔥Well, maybe not full vengeance. But she is back and interested in picking up things where your relationship left off in FL Week 3. Fresh from a return trip back home to South Korea, the only thing on her mind is reconnecting and finishing her degree.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/ba3598e12f29b6d703e513ab8016c6ac85b3ee85.png"][/img][/p][p]But come on, this is Min, one of the naughtiest women in Crowning. She's not just going to keep her head in a book all game, is she? Of course not! Her story in Fetish Locator S&M will eventually have her joining up the team, but there is no need to rush right?[/p][p][/p][p]First things first, Min wants to make sure that Stacy can keep up with you. We all know her competitive side, and if she is going to be part of a studio (cough harem 💞), she wants to make sure everyone involved can bring their A-game. 🔥🔥🔥[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/f287ee5eb3a1df65c0be93cc286655574243df5c.png"][/img][/p][p]Will Stacy be up to the challenge? Or will she have to use her Trap Card? 💀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/bda05a7399b0772773cc43688f71bbff9302b34c.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll find out all the answers when Season 1 of Fetish Locator S&M comes out later this year.[/p][p][/p][p]Ciao and have a great day! [/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Meet the Studio: Lyssa Harris
notes.content:
[p]Many things describe Lyssa Harris. Lawyer 👩‍⚖️. Jokester. Potential Vampire. One thing people are always saying is that this beyond charming individual is someone incredible to have in your corner.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/1626a401a3d68f45cf39a751f52c005a6483678f.png"][/img][/p][p]Players got the chance to meet Lyssa way back in Fetish Locator Week 1 at the very first Fetish Locator party. From that point, fans interested in trans content, or even those a bit curious, got to see Lyssa in her natural element across each chapter of our first game. Lyssa even got to play a role in helping you take down the menace behind the Fetish Locator app. 👾[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/2bab2aa6e66f12f6dbea7e0e598aaa0c0a38f355.png"][/img][/p][p]Zoom forward to Fetish Locator S&M Studio, and we get to see Lyssa in action once again. If you are interested in Lyssa, you will be able to reignite and continue the relationship you began in the original Fetish Locator Trilogy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/ba0c4f8e7ca1eeb73ec7d6526d91b2817a2775ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You'll get to go on new dates 😙 with her, share new experiences, and even get some legal assistance from her brilliant mind from time to time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/3d7ed2989252efc5afd041f00a56171e28320f3b.png"][/img][/p][p]Last and certainly not least,  if you are interested in a throuple path with Stacy and Lyssa included, that is something else we have been building with the characters and their stories. 😍[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/50fb59bbf9e0b9b5972dc0c7f6732020dd10b729.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In closing, Lyssa always brings a little extra to her scenes. Whether she is working as your legal advisor or spending some quality time with you, she's always perked up and ready for a challenge. You'll never find a harder-working and more cunning woman in the Fetish Locator world. And if you're really lucky, you'll get to see the wild side of everyone's favorite trans character. [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The 9th update of Fetish Locator: S&M Studio is live on Patreon!
notes.content: [p][b][i]Hey, friends![/i][/b][/p][p]Since the point when you and Stacy left everything behind to chase your dreams and conquer the world of adult cinema, it’s all been leading to this. This is the moment in the adventure where fantasies become reality, and ideas take form on screen. [/p][p][/p][p]In the [b][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/135260237"]ninth release of S&M Studio[/url],[/b] you’ll shoot your very first [b]feature-length film[/b] in your own studio—complete with models, sets, and a script that you and your team brought to life together.[/p][p]This is far more than just a technical leap forward. It’s a creative milestone, packed with passion, challenges, and ambition. And with so many juicy behind-the-scenes events, you’ll get to see familiar characters in entirely new ways. [/p][p][/p][p]Working with Stacy, Kanya, and Taisia, you’ll go through every step of production: writing the script, building the sets, designing costumes, and finally shooting your masterpiece. This storyline of making a movie is the heart of the 9th release—and trust us, you won’t want to miss a second of it. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/ca4fd2b21f66fc5c9745c5d6583f03bc2257aff5.png"][/img][/p][p]But the action doesn’t stop on the set. A sudden [b]cyberattack[/b] hits the IT department’s servers—and now the whole team is counting on you and your brilliant tech experts, April and Nari.[/p][p]You’ll need to act fast and work as one to stop the threat and save the project. And after that kind of stress, there’s only one thing left to do… help the girls unwind. [/p][p][/p][p]Let’s start with [b]Claire[/b]. A closed-door office meeting with her quickly turns into something far more personal. Just be sure to be mindful that in the office, you never know who else is watching. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've stuck around through [b]April's [/b]stubbornness, you'll now get to see a new side of her as she tries to balance her work at Orbix and her responsibilities to her bandmates. The code monkey offers you a chance to go for a jog in the park, just be sure to keep up, or you might miss out on the thrilling ending.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/2a2b910dd0957e27dc5e5da5a32655cd1b0db907.png"][/img][/p][p]For fans of [b]Lyssa[/b], we’ve got a double treat in this update. First, you’ll head out on a playful and colorful [b]date at the amusement park[/b] with both Lyssa and Stacy. Then, back at your studio, get ready for a [b]sizzling[/b] [b]photoshoot[/b] with the sexiest lawyer you know.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/563690fc8390de0602ee4156e162e15f4528e2e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]💥 Here’s what’s waiting for you in this release:[/b][/p][p]— [b]25 new scenes [/b] [/p][p]— [b]3718 new renders [/b] [/p][p]— [b]251 animations[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We want to thank each and every one of you for your patience, support, and love for this project. You’re the reason we keep pushing ourselves to make each update better than the last. [/p][p][/p][p]And just a reminder—[b]S&M Studio now has an official Steam page [/b]so you can wishlist it right not to stay updated.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763690/Fetish_Locator_SM_Studio/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]See you on set! 🎬💋[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Meet the Studio - AmRose Jenkins
notes.content: [p]AmRose is coming back! For those that don't know, AmRose was the roommate of your first girlfriend before all the Fetish Locator insanity started. She is one of the sweetest (and hottest) characters in FL Weeks 1-3, and she will naturally play a role in Fetish Locator S&M Studio.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/a435029ae4fb132bfaf2d077518443bb988a99f9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]AmRose will not join your crew immediately, but the cute redhead will play a significant role in your studio and the story of S&M during our first season. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/1efdeaee9aca71be7c762552d416defc844974d8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]At the end of FL Week 3, AmRose had different ideas of where to take things. Ideas that came into conflict with you and Stacy. While this definitely put a wall between you and your gorgeous girlfriend, it doesn't mean that the attraction and love between you two has been snuffed out completely. It will be up to you if you want to rekindle things into a full relationship, or if you prefer just to remain friends after everything that happened.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/d0dd779dc37b920866169430d0a389a534b8bdf2.png"][/img][/p][p]Whether or not you return to a relationship with AmRose, make sure to stay frosty. AmRose can be just as cunning as Stacy, and she might have a little more in mind beyond reigniting the fires between you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/1324999b70bad8d1a2f88e3458d6f7f88f85d596.png"][/img][/p][p]I hope everyone will enjoy the next part of her chapter in the Fetish Locator universe when she joins many other amazing characters when Fetish Locator S&M Season 1 releases near the end of the year.[/p][p]Have a great week![/p][p]-Vinovella[/p]

notes.title: Meet the Studio - Kanya Vu
notes.content:
[p]Kanya Vu is the skilled cameragirl who is going to be a key element of your team. She's cute, perky, and always ready to work.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/ca13b6b8f6aa9d6c817cc1e5cf6ddd6c3ec3c1a7.png"][/img][/p][p]Kanya finished college and while she didn't participate in the Fetish Locator Phoenomenon. That doesn't mean she doesn't have a very kinky side.[/p][p]Our turquoise-haired gal is pretty much the first person you ask to join your team for the studio. Kanya is ready to help with the camera side of things, and that includes giving you some pointers to make you into a decent camera operator yourself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/37ca112a5d1d856ed8ecfeb5b7af709918d104c7.png"][/img][/p][p]She also has a mindset that likes to make sure things keep moving forward when she is on the job. Her more professional personality does see her knock heads with some characters, but when it's time to clock out, she parties with the best of them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/73d5d110234a00025cbbbe3b7a7b24905134a06f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Kanya will play a big role in the main story, but she will also connect you to other individuals in the Fetish Locator world, so make sure to visit her at the Photo Dojo often.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/e0eca20552b60a2583f9513e22128bdf156d2015.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to see more of Kanya, make sure to wishlist Fetish Locator S&M Studio now so you're up to date on all the news about the game, including information about our eventual release date near the end of the year.[/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]Vinovella[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Adventure on the High Seas
notes.content: [p]Ahoy Landlubbers![/p][p][/p][p]We're at the halfway point of July, and it's been 12 days since the launch of our page. It's been an exciting month for the Fetish Locator team. Having the Steam page live is a great stepping stone for our new title, but of course, a lot of hard work remains. Including some costume shopping. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/af4b2e1a49b6679618ae24834cd086bb0015b5ed.png"][/img][/p][p]Since May, the team has been hard at work crafting the story and inner workings of the first Feature Film that you and Stacy will be creating once your studio has been renovated in the Main Quest of S&M.[/p][p]There will be two Feature Films in Season 1, and this first one has been an epic in the making. We're going to bring you back to a time of adventure and cutlasses as Stacy, you, and the crew embark on a Pirate adventure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668906/af33f3e4fd09f6058a73f0f1934def777da408b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]All the writing for this movie has been written, so it's just a matter of crafting a few remaining renders and sizzling animations. Then, once we have it all coded up, this part will be slotted into the upcoming epic that is [b]Fetish Locator S&M.[/b][/p][p]If you haven't already, make sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist so you're always updated when the game is released near the end of the year.[/p][p]Until then, keep your rum full and your sword ready.[/p][p]-Vinovella[/p]
